jobs.description:
German-Speaking Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Schedule: Part-time, 30 hours/week
Compensation: €15/hour + performance-based incentives
Work Location: Fully Remote
Contract: Freelance cooperation agreement

About the Opportunity

TalentWorldGroup is currently looking for a German-speaking Sales Development Representatives for a project with a leading company in the vacation rental industry.

About the Role

This is a pre-sales SDR position, focused on outbound calling and lead qualification, rather than closing sales.

You would contact vacation rental property owners, introduce the client, assess their interest, qualify potential leads, and transfer qualified prospects to the Sales Managers.

Your Responsibilities

  • Make outbound calls to vacation rental homeowners

  • Introduce the client and explain the service

  • Identify interest and qualify potential leads

  • Build rapport and handle initial questions and objections

  • Transfer qualified leads to Sales Managers

  • Maintain accurate information in the CRM

  • Manage follow-ups and lead handovers

  • Participate in KPI reviews and performance discussions

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent-level German (C2)

  • Strong professional English, as our internal communication, training and team collaboration are conducted in English

  • At least 2 years of experience in cold calling, outbound sales or lead generation

  • Confidence speaking with prospects by telephone

  • Experience handling objections

  • Familiarity with CRMs and lead databases

  • Goal-oriented, organized and self-motivated

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Working Hours

30 hours per week, Monday to Friday, CET:

  • Monday: 10:30 – 14:00 and 15:00- 19:00

  • Tuesday: 15:00 – 19:00

  • Wednesday: 10:30 – 14:00 and 15:00- 19:00

  • Thursday: 10:30 – 14:00 and 15:00- 19:00

  • Friday: 10:30 – 14:00

Training

The anticipated training period is in September 2026, subject to the final project timeline and client confirmation. ﻿Five hours of unpaid training to be organized within a week of start date, according to everyone's availability

Technical Requirements

  • Stable broadband internet connection (LAN preferred)

  • Processor: 1.8 GHz or higher

  • 8 GB RAM minimum

  • 10 GB available storage

  • 1920 × 1080 screen resolution recommended

  • Wired USB headset

  • Windows 11 or later / macOS 14+

What We Offer

  • €15/hour + performance-based incentives

  • Fully remote work

  • Part-time, 20 hours/week

  • Freelance cooperation agreement

  • Long-term project potential

  • Structured onboarding and ongoing support

  • Access to additional opportunities within our international talent pool

  • Career development opportunities

  • Performance rewards and gamification programs

If you have the required German level, strong English communication skills and substantial cold-calling/lead-generation experience, we would be happy to speak with you during the pre-screening stage and keep your profile under consideration for the upcoming project.

jobs.title: Commercial Lead – Platform
jobs.excerpt: Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
jobs.description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Role Purpose

Keyloop powers automotive retail for 20,000+ retailers and 80 OEMs across 90+ countries. As Commercial Lead for Platform, you're the SME for how we take our data platform to market – the layer that unlocks the data sitting across our expansive portfolio, so customers can leverage it to drive amazing car buying and ownership journeys, and unlock real ROI from AI.

You'll build a strategy that supports and strengthens our Enterprise sales motion, working with Sales, Product and Partners to sell it faster and better. Ultimately, this role exists to help us capitalise on the opportunity ahead, as we move through a significant phase of innovation and new product launches. Success is measured by growth in the domain and adoption of the strategies and Sales Plays you create – not a personal quota or channel you own.

Key Responsibilities

    • Identify and prioritise the OEMs and groups with the biggest opportunity to unlock value from data and AI, to drive scaled growth.
    • Act as client-facing SME on strategic platform pitches, engaging CDOs, Heads of Data and architects, and helping account and sales teams win.
    • Work with Product and Sales Leadership to build a strategy that supports and strengthens our Enterprise sales motion for our data platform.
    • Work with Product to define how the platform is packaged for Mid-Market and Velocity teams.
    • Work with Product to keep the platform class-leading, showing customers how unified data drives better car buying and ownership journeys and stronger ROI from AI.
    • Define partner requirements and support the Partner team on integration and implementation.
    • Own the Sales Play for our platform and drive its adoption across every motion.
    • Track and evidence the results customers see from unlocking their data and AI, and use them to strengthen the pitch.

What You'll Bring

    • Deep expertise in platform, data or integration software, credible with technical client stakeholders.
    • Experience shaping go-to-market strategy for technical, platform-level products.
    • Track record working with Product and Partner teams to scale into new use cases.
    • Comfortable proving customer outcomes and using them commercially.
    • Strong cross-functional influence, without formal authority over sales, product or partner teams.

Why join us?

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

An inclusive environment to thrive

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

Be rewarded for your efforts

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."

jobs.title: Field Engineer - Ohio
jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewAt Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Motorola Solutions is a world leader in the field of professional mobile communications systems with an impressive heritage of technological innovations and a global base of installed systems. The group's main business is the implementation of mission-critical digital mobile communication systems for Government & Public Safety Communications customers.


Job Description

Note: This is a remote position with travel (50-75%+) to support projects within the territory (OH, WI, MI, MN, SD, ND). The candidates must reside in or be open to relocation to OH.

Overview:

The Field Engineer is responsible for the Implementation of complex communication system infrastructure and technical support of specialized sub-systems and product applications, This includes troubleshooting software-driven electronics, IP networks, server and network hardware, and performance verification and optimization of RF and broadband architecture including, legacy analog, advanced digital P25, and data infrastructure devices and systems.

Responsibilities include:

  • Team with Systems Engineering, Project Management, and Sales personnel to effectively design, implement, optimize, test, cutover, and document advanced communication systems that meet or exceed customer expectations

  • Provide weekly reports of activities and accomplishments.

  • Utilizes system design drawings, planners, and product documentation to oversee the onsite installation of network, server, and RF equipment. Provides as-built information for the final system documentation package.

  • Utilizes network design tools, formalized process documents, and customer input to perform onsite and remote configuration of network, server, RF, and databases. Provides as-configured documentation and baseline reports.

  • Utilizes system logs and tools to perform onsite and remote troubleshooting of networks, servers, databases, and RF infrastructure. Verifies system logs and event monitoring applications are clear of any faults.

  • Utilizes product and system test plans to perform acceptance testing. Corrects any deficiencies found during testing. Provides accepted test results for the final system documentation package.

  • Utilizes product specifications, FCC license data, and design parameters to perform performance verification/optimization of advanced digital and legacy analog RF infrastructure. Provides baseline measurement data and accepted test results for the final system documentation package.

  • Utilizes project design drawings and customer current system information to design/develop solutions to difficult technical issues encountered as part of system implementation, upgrades, or support issues.

  • Perform preventative maintenance routines to ensure proper system operation with a focus on trend analysis and documentation of results

Specific Knowledge/Skills:

  • Unique combinations of multi-site RF communications systems and computer/networking skills are required.

  • Strong knowledge of LAN/WAN IP networks, and must be proficient in computer network installation, configuration, and maintenance of systems including cabling, routers, switches, and firewalls.

​Experience with installation, administration, and troubleshooting of:

  • Server Virtualization, specifically with VMWare ESXi v.6+ and\or Microsoft Hyper-V 2012+

  • Server Operating Systems, specifically Windows Server 2008 R2, 2012 R2 and 2019

  • Workstation Operating Systems, specifically Windows 7 & 10

  • Switches, routers, firewalls, specifically HP and Juniper

  • Knowledge of secure products/protocols (KMF, KVL, AES)

  • Knowledge of RF systems, such as transmitters, receivers, filters, and antenna networks

  • Demonstrate systems experience and have related experience with the relevant equipment

  • Knowledge of standard telephony and dedicated data circuits, as well as knowledge of packet-switching techniques

  • Experience with logging recording systems

  • Skilled in the use of various communications test equipment including:

    • Communication system analyzers (S412E LMR Master, Viavi 3920B)

    • RF Power Sensor

    • Ethernet test sets (Anritsu 9090A, VeeX MTX150, T-BERD 5800

    • T1 test sets

    • TIMS (Transmission Impairment Measurement Set)​​

  • Highly computer literate with proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, and Google G-Suite applications

  • Strong self-management skills and "people" skills to work closely with customers and partner community, as well as Sales, Systems Engineering, Project Management, and Customer Service teams

  • Self-motivated and self-managed to perform the required duties at a distance from direct supervision

  • Able to operate under stressful situations to resolve customer problems quickly

Note: This is a remote position with travel (50-75%+) to support projects within the territory (OH, WI, MI, MN, SD, ND). The candidates must reside in or be open to relocation to OH.

Target Base Salary Range: $60,000 - $80,000 USD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.


Basic Requirements

  • Associate's Degree in a technical or engineering discipline and 4+ years of technical or engineering experience

  • OR 6+ years technical or engineering experience

  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position


Travel Requirements

50-75%


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Experienced


Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Our U.S. Benefits include:

  • Incentive Bonus Plans

  • Medical, Dental, Vision benefits

  • 401K with Company Match

  • 10 Paid Holidays

  • Generous Paid Time Off Packages

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Paid Parental & Family Leave

  • and more!

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

jobs.excerpt: The AI-powered OS for beauty, wellness and self-care About Fresha Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.
jobs.description:
The AI-powered OS for beauty,

wellness and self-care


About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role Overview

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Executive to join our global business.

Reporting directly to the General Manager of Southern Europe and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and strategic partners, you will be 100% focused on driving new business growth and expanding Fresha's presence across the region.

This is a remote role, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a high-growth territory while helping to accelerate Fresha's expansion. You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and engaging beauty and wellness businesses in your region, combining proactive field sales activity with a consultative approach to build strong local relationships and drive commercial success.

This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, enjoys working autonomously, embraces challenges, and wants to make a tangible impact on the growth of a leading global technology platform.

What you will be doing

  • KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets
  • Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (in-person meetings as appropriate)
  • Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners
  • Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close
  • Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives
  • Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience
  • Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry
  • Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM
  • Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities
    • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What we are looking for

  • Experience - Minimum 1 years of solid B2B sales with a track record of success
  • Industry - SaaS, online marketplaces, or payment platforms is highly desirable
  • Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
  • Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively
  • Curiosity - You are naturally curious and have a desire to continually grow and develop

Added bonus

  • Bi-lingual - Fluency in Spanish and another language - preferably Basque
  • Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry
    • At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview process

  • Screening Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)
  • 1st Stage - Video interview with Team Lead (45 mins)
  • Final Stage + Presentation - Video interview with Team Lead and General Manager (Europe) (75 mins)
    • We aim to finalise the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.
    Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe.

Inclusive workforce

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

jobs.description:
Req ID:386618

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Senior Tecsys Elite WMS / Distribution ERP Specialist - Remote to join our team in Dallas, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).

Senior Tecsys Elite WMS / Distribution ERP L3 Application Support Specialist

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Tecsys Elite WMS / Distribution ERP L3 Application Support Specialist to provide advanced production support for warehouse, distribution, and supply chain operations.

You will serve as the Level 2/Level 3 escalation point for Tecsys-related issues, working closely with operations, IT, integration, infrastructure, automation, external vendors, and Tecsys support teams.

This is a hands-on role focused on complex troubleshooting, integrations, application stability, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

  • Provide L2/L3 production support for Tecsys Elite WMS and Elite Distribution ERP.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving inventory, orders, transactions, interfaces, printing, jobs, performance, configuration, and user access.
  • Investigate application logs, SQL/data, interface messages, file transfers, job status, and transaction workflows.
  • Support integrations with ERP, EDI, carriers, automation/WCS, RF devices, reporting, label-printing, customer, and supplier systems.
  • Troubleshoot APIs/web services, EDI, SFTP/FTP, batch jobs, middleware, and file- or message-based interfaces.
  • Coordinate transaction retries, reprocessing, reconciliation, and recovery activities.
  • Lead high-priority incident triage, impact assessment, communication, escalation, and resolution.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and identify opportunities to prevent recurring incidents.
  • Manage escalations with Tecsys and third-party vendors, providing detailed troubleshooting information and supporting evidence.
  • Support approved configuration changes, workflow updates, master-data corrections, security changes, releases, cutovers, and hypercare.
  • Maintain troubleshooting guides, runbooks, escalation procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials.
  • Mentor L1/L2 support teams and business super users on common issues and support procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience supporting WMS, ERP, distribution, or supply chain applications.
  • 4+ years of hands-on Tecsys Elite experience, or strong enterprise WMS/Distribution ERP experience with the ability to quickly learn Tecsys.
  • Strong understanding of warehouse and distribution processes, including:
    • Inbound and receiving
    • Order fulfillment
    • Inventory management and cycle counting
    • Procurement
    • Returns
    • Shipping and distribution
    • Enterprise system handoffs
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across application configuration, transactions, master data, integrations, reporting, security, devices, and operational workflows.
  • Experience supporting integrations using APIs/web services, EDI, SFTP/FTP, batch jobs, and file-based interfaces.
  • Ability to use SQL for troubleshooting, data validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience with incident, problem, change, release, and vendor management processes.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ITSM platforms.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with business users, IT teams, technical teams, and vendors.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct production support experience with Tecsys Elite WMS and Elite Distribution ERP.
  • Experience with Tecsys Itopia and/or additional Tecsys modules such as:
    • Transportation Management (TMS)
    • Delivery Management
    • TecsysIQ / Analytics
    • Order Management
  • Experience with relational databases, Oracle, Linux/Unix, Windows, scripting, job scheduling, monitoring tools, or cloud/SaaS environments.
  • Experience supporting upgrades, releases, implementations, go-lives, cutovers, and hypercare.
  • Experience in large-scale warehouse, distribution, logistics, or supply chain environments.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you'll help ensure stable, reliable warehouse and distribution operations by:

  • Resolving critical production issues quickly.
  • Reducing recurring incidents and manual workarounds.
  • Improving transaction reliability and system performance.
  • Maintaining accurate and reconciled WMS, ERP, and shipping transactions.
  • Supporting successful Tecsys releases, upgrades, and enhancements.
  • Improving support processes, documentation, and knowledge across the organization.

The Ideal Candidate

You are a hands-on application support professional who understands both technology and warehouse operations. You can quickly diagnose complex problems, work calmly during production incidents, communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders, and collaborate effectively with developers, infrastructure teams, vendors, and business users.

If you have strong Tecsys Elite, WMS, distribution, integration, and production support experience, this is an opportunity to play a key role in keeping critical supply chain operations running reliably.

Pay Transparency

Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $92,408-$179,699. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Eversight, part of Instacart, is building next-generation data insights and analytics platforms that help leading CPGs & Retailers make smarter, faster decisions across pricing, promotions, retail media, and omni-commerce. We're hiring a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to build and run end-to-end revenue operations across our Commercial organization (Sales and Customer Success), spanning both CPG and Retail. This is a build-and-own role, not a request-response one: you'll identify what the business needs before it's escalated to you, bring a recommendation, and drive it to completion. You'll report directly to the Director of Sales Capabilities & Strategy, with broad latitude to design process, own reporting, and act as a trusted partner to commercial leadership across Eversight Sales, Customer Success, and Product, along with cross functional partners like Strategic Finance, Commercial Partnerships and Brand Partnerships.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Standardized reporting and forecasting models live across CPG and Retail, giving commercial leadership one clear view of pipeline, renewals, and customer health
  • Dashboards built and adopted across Sales and Customer Success that leadership actually uses to make decisions, tracking pipeline, renewal rate, expansion, and churn risk
  • Operational gaps identified and fixed before anyone had to ask, each tied to a measurable improvement in forecast accuracy, data integrity, or process efficiency
  • AI tools, agents, and workflow automations built and shipped that eliminate recurring reporting and data cleanup work, cutting manual operational overhead across the commercial org
  • Trusted operational relationships built across every team you touch, with clean handoffs and no surprises
  • Process documentation and standardized frameworks built as you go, not bolted on after the fact

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, or related field
  • 7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar function within a SaaS company; experience in CPG, Retail, or trade promotion/pricing analytics highly preferred
  • Proven ability to analyze and interpret complex data sets to deliver actionable insight
  • Fluent in using AI tools, agents, and workflow automations to eliminate manual reporting and data cleanup, as a core part of how you operate rather than an occasional add-on
  • Experience with SQL and Tableau
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present findings to leadership
  • Demonstrated ability to identify challenges, prioritize solutions, and execute improvements independently
  • Adept at working cross-functionally with a focus on aligning multiple stakeholders toward shared goals
  • A self-starter able to operate independently in a fast-paced environment

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • MBA
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and Planhat (or comparable CS platform)
  • Understanding of the CPG trade promotion, pricing, and revenue growth management landscape
  • Understanding of the Retail Merchandising landscape

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

About the Role

The Product Manager (Payments) is a core execution role within WEX's Health & Benefits digital organization. This role is responsible for driving the delivery and continuous improvement of WEX's payment products — including HSA debit card rails, claims reimbursement flows, ACH/RTP money movement, real-time payment notifications, and spend authorization logic — that sit at the intersection of member experience and financial operations.

This PM operates with a strong bias for outcomes over output: they connect every feature decision to adoption, retention, cost-to-serve, or revenue impact. They bring domain fluency in healthcare payments and fintech, use AI-enabled workflows as a default starting point for synthesis and analysis, and are trusted partners across engineering, compliance, operations, and external payment vendors.

This role is the payments execution engine for H&B's product organization. The right candidate is someone who is equally comfortable reviewing ACH return codes and presenting trade-off recommendations to senior stakeholders — and who makes disciplined prioritization decisions with incomplete information.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

As a Product Manager for Payments you will:

  • Execution & Outcomes-Oriented Delivery (60%): Own end-to-end execution for payment product features including HSA debit card rails, claims auto-adjudication, ACH/RTP money movement, and real-time payment notifications. Actively participate in and facilitate core Scrum ceremonies (e.g., Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Refinement, Demos, Retrospectives), stepping up to lead ceremonies as needed. Drive short-term delivery with a bias for speed, iterating quickly based on stakeholder feedback and outcome data. Ensure delivery choices connect directly to adoption, revenue, and operational efficiency targets.

  • Discovery & Strategy Support (15%): Lead discovery for payments-specific product problems — including spend authorization flows, payment partner integrations, and compliance-adjacent money movement constraints. Synthesize customer insight, payment industry signals, and competitive intelligence into testable hypotheses. Use AI-enabled research tools to accelerate synthesis while maintaining rigorous human judgment on conclusions.

  • Insights-Driven Decision Making (10%):Navigate payment-specific metrics including authorization rates, decline rates, transaction error rates, auto-adjudication throughput, and cost-per-transaction. Use both qualitative and quantitative inputs to drive prioritization decisions. Cross-check AI-generated analysis against source data and apply appropriate rigor based on decision reversibility and risk.

  • Collaboration & Trusted Partnership (10%):Drive effective communication with engineering, compliance, finance, operations, and external payment partners (card networks, ACH processors, custodians). Clarify decision ownership, proactively resolve impediments, and ensure no ambiguity turns into delivery drift. Understand the H&B payment strategy and contribute grounded ideas on sequencing and trade-offs.

  • Customer Obsession & Learning (5%): Identify friction in the member payment experience — from card declines and reimbursement delays to claims submission errors — and translate trends into actionable product improvements. Participate in customer empathy sessions with employers, members, and brokers. Apply a test-and-learn approach to validate payment UX hypotheses before full build.

Your Skillset:

  • Payments Domain Expertise: Working knowledge of healthcare payment ecosystems: HSA/FSA/HRA debit card rails (Visa/Mastercard), ACH, RTP/FedNow, and claims reimbursement workflows. Familiarity with payment compliance constraints: IRS 213(d) substantiation rules, IIAS, Reg E, and AML/KYC implications for benefits accounts. Understanding of payment partner ecosystem: card processors, custodial bank partners, clearinghouses, and third-party payment APIs.

  • Product Execution: Ability to own end-to-end delivery for complex, dependency-heavy payment features across experience, technology, compliance, and operations.Strong prioritization discipline — can distinguish important from urgent, articulate feature trade-offs in business terms, and make bounded calls without full consensus.Comfortable operating with incomplete data; explicit about confidence levels, risk, and what still needs validation. Demonstrated track record in Agile product delivery, with hands-on experience participating in and leading team Scrum ceremonies.

  • Discovery & Customer Empathy:Experience leading discovery for payment-adjacent product problems, translating member and employer pain points into testable hypotheses. Participates in direct customer research; understands the 'why' behind payment friction — not just what members click but what prevents them from completing transactions or claiming reimbursements. AI-Native Execution: Uses AI as a default starting point for research synthesis, competitive analysis, and requirements drafting — while maintaining human accountability for judgment, risk framing, and final product decisions. Able to design AI-assisted workflows that remove manual steps without simply layering tools on top of existing habits.

  • Commercial Instinct & Systems Thinking: Connects roadmap decisions to adoption, efficiency, and revenue/retention impact — not just feature completeness.Understands how payment product choices affect cost-to-serve, operational load, error rates, and member financial outcomes.

  • Collaboration & Influence: Establishes clear decision ownership; keeps cross-functional teams aligned without requiring universal consensus before moving.Communicates clearly to engineering, compliance, finance, and operations partners; adapts narrative for technical and non-technical audiences.

Required Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree in business, technology, computer science, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of professional experience, including 2+ years in product management roles with direct ownership of feature delivery.

  • Demonstrated experience in fintech, healthcare payments, or consumer financial products — with hands-on knowledge of payment rails, money movement, or benefits account platforms.

  • Proven ability to translate customer and operational insights into testable hypotheses and ship short-to-medium-term product outcomes.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, compliance, operations, and external vendor partners.

  • Comfort with both qualitative and quantitative analysis; ability to navigate data dashboards and make decisions with imperfect information.

  • Prior experience at a health benefits administrator, HSA/FSA/HRA platform, or fintech company

  • Familiarity with IRS substantiation requirements (IIAS, 213(d)), Reg E, and AML/KYC frameworks in a benefits payment context.

  • Experience with real-time payment (RTP/FedNow) or ACH product development.

  • Working knowledge of claims adjudication logic or auto-adjudication workflows.

  • Experience designing AI-assisted product workflows — using LLMs or agents to accelerate research, synthesis, or insight generation.

  • MBA or equivalent graduate education in business, technology, or health systems.

What will give you an edge:

Drawing from WEX's Digital Competencies 3.0 framework, the Payments PM at level III demonstrates:

  • Scope: Owns outcomes for a defined set of payment features. Independently connects digital work to customer value, operational realities, and business objectives — not just shipping features on time.

  • Discovery: Independently leads discovery by synthesizing customer insights, generating hypotheses, and designing lightweight experiments. Connects opportunity spaces to revenue levers and cost-to-serve implications, not just roadmap slots.

  • Decision Quality: Makes timely calls by combining data, model outputs, and frontline context. Explicit about confidence levels and what still needs validation before proceeding.

  • AI-Native Execution: Uses AI as the first pass for repeatable work — drafting, synthesis, competitive research — while keeping human accountability for judgment, escalation, and risk decisions.

  • Commercial Instinct: Connects every initiative to customer value, revenue, margin, retention, or operating efficiency. Frames payment features in terms of business outcomes, not just technical requirements.

  • Systems Thinking: Understands how payment product choices ripple through downstream operations, compliance obligations, member experience, and financial performance.

Travel Requirements:

  • Travel %: 5%

  • Overnight Travel %: 5%

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

As a Guidance Navigation and Controls Analysis Engineer you will help lead development of Ursa Major vehicle GNC capabilities. This role will assess dynamic environments, determine appropriate sensor suite and configurations for varying vehicle designs, establish guidance designs. This role will develop GNC system designs into robust, flight-ready software, working across simulation, test, embedded implementation, and hardware-in-the-loop environments. This role is responsible for the 0 to 1 development of major portions of a flight control system, in tight, cross functional coordination with vehicle design, structures and avionics. This role will develop algorithms and associated simulations, ensure compatibility with system design constraints, and validate performance leveraging a mix of Linear Systems Analysis, State Space Methods, Monte Carlo Analysis and deep coordination with Hardware in the Loop analysis of the full system. This position is available to work remote from within the United States or on-site/hybrid in Berthoud, Colorado.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain flight GNC systems for aerospace applications
  • Translate GNC requirements into models and into efficient, reliable embedded software
  • Develop and execute simulations to evaluate guidance, navigation, and control performance
  • Coordinate with design to ensure that vehicle design parameters align with control system requirements.
  • Support system integration, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and flight test activities
  • Analyze test and flight data to assess performance and drive improvements
  • Contribute to requirements definition, verification, and traceability for GNC functions
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks through analysis, testing, and peer review

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • Professional experience developing GNC models and algorithms for aerospace or defense systems
  • Strong understanding of classical control, estimation, and vehicle dynamics
  • Experience implementing algorithms in MATLAB/Simulink, C/C++, or Python or equivalent
  • Ability to work effectively across disciplines and communicate technical concepts clearly
  • Ability to work effectively in teams or individually

Desirable Experience:

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in a relevant engineering discipline
  • Experience with navigation sensors (IMUs, GPS, star trackers, etc.) and state estimation techniques (e.g., Kalman filtering)
  • Exposure to hardware-in-the-loop testing, flight testing, or operational flight systems
  • Familiarity with safety-critical or regulated development environments (e.g., DO-178 or equivalent processes)

jobs.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Instacart Catalog team is the product data infrastructure powering everything customers see, find, and trust across the marketplace. We ingest data from retailers and third-party sources and use AI/ML and human operations to validate, enrich, and publish product information at scale. At the heart of this infrastructure are product attributes — the structured descriptors that power search filters, item card badges, dietary safety signals, health personalization, brand advertising, and agentic commerce. They touch every major surface and every major stakeholder.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the product data layer that determines how customers find what they need, how brands show up on shelf, and how Instacart earns trust as the definitive source of grocery product data. In this role, you'll set the end-to-end strategy for catalog attributes, lead governance, and drive accuracy and coverage at scale — building the kind of trust that brands, retailers, and internal teams depend on.

You'll work alongside a team of 7 engineers and partner closely with Machine Learning and Operations, as part of a broader product org of 4 PMs on the Catalog team. You'll thrive here if you love operating at the intersection of ML/AI, operations, and commercial partner relationships — and can hold a complex, multi-sided system together with clear thinking and strong execution.

About the Job

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for catalog attributes — aligning cross-functional partners around clear outcomes, success metrics, and milestones, and maintaining a roadmap process transparent enough that every side of the marketplace can depend on it.
  • Translate ambiguous, complex problems into structured plans and drive execution from discovery and prioritization through launch, iteration, and scale, spanning a development process that includes Ops, Engineering, ML, Legal, and commercial partners.
  • Use data and customer insights to run experiments, understand root causes, and design solutions that balance speed and accuracy across the attribute lifecycle — defining KPIs, interpreting results, and making sound tradeoffs between precision and recall.
  • Build strong relationships and feedback loops across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Machine Learning, Sales, Ads, Search, Legal, Brand, and Support — communicating transparently to drive clarity, commitment, and shared ownership of attribute quality.
  • Establish and continuously improve mechanisms for operational excellence — owning governance rituals, quality dashboards, postmortems, and platform investments that make attribute quality defensible at scale and compound over time.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent in catalog, data platforms, content systems, or ML/AI-adjacent products — including ownership of complex, cross-functional programs with measurable impact.
  • Proven ability to set strategy, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver high-quality outcomes in fast-paced, dynamic environments — including building governance structures and quality systems, not just shipping features.
  • Demonstrated proficiency using data to drive decisions — defining KPIs, partnering with Analytics, interpreting experiments, and reasoning about precision/recall and ML model tradeoffs — with comfort navigating ambiguity to find clarity.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of building trust and alignment across high-stakeholder-count environments where no single team controls all the inputs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, e-commerce, or consumer technology, with familiarity balancing multi-sided incentives.
  • Hands-on experience with experimentation and analytics — including A/B testing, SQL, and dashboards — and the ability to partner deeply with Engineering and Data teams.
  • Experience with product attribute systems, catalog data, content management, or source prioritization at marketplace scale.
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML extraction workflows, or quality evaluation frameworks such as golden set audits, human-in-the-loop review, or precision/recall measurement.
  • History of translating commercial commitments into engineering requirements, or prior work at the intersection of legal/compliance and data products — including rights management, regulatory compliance attributes, or data sourcing constraints.
  • People leadership experience — direct or cross-functional — with a genuine passion for coaching, feedback, and fostering inclusive team culture.

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior IT Engineer to serve as a senior technical contributor on Posit's IT Operations team, supporting our distributed workforce, corporate systems, and enterprise AI infrastructure.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior IT Engineer to serve as a senior technical contributor on Posit's IT Operations team, supporting our distributed workforce, corporate systems, and enterprise AI infrastructure. The ideal candidate is a seasoned systems administrator and support engineer who has moved beyond day-to-day ticket response and is ready to take ownership of critical platforms, lead cross-team technical efforts, and mentor more junior team members. You'll play a leading role in operating our IT infrastructure, raising the bar on our processes and documentation, and ensuring the productivity and security of our employees. IT Operations owns and runs the platforms everything else rides on — identity, endpoints, SaaS systems, the enterprise AI platform, and the infrastructure for our enterprise automation platform. Our department's mission is to empower Posit's employees with reliable technology, maintain a robust IT environment, and operate the platform foundation for the company's enterprise AI program. You will collaborate closely with other teams across the organization to achieve our departmental mission. We achieve this through proactive system management, responsive user support, code-driven operations, and continuous process improvement, enabling innovation with effective IT solutions. Since its inception, Posit has operated as a 100% distributed company with a SaaS-first infrastructure, complemented by select platforms we host and manage ourselves in AWS. This presents unique challenges and requires pragmatism, creativity, and a collaborative, detail-oriented approach to be successful.

You will own:

  • End-to-end ownership of one or more core IT platforms (platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, Jamf Pro, Zoom, Slack, or the infrastructure for automation platforms such as n8n, Workato, or Okta Workflows) — including configuration, health, security posture, and roadmap. For the automation platform, that means the platform itself — hosting, upgrades, access, backups, and monitoring — while IT Engineering builds the workflows within it. While most of our stack is SaaS, some platforms are self-hosted in AWS, and that infrastructure is ours to run.
  • Complex technical escalations across end user devices (Mac, Windows, Linux) and SaaS applications, serving as the senior point of contact when issues exceed the scope of Tier 1 support.
  • Design and implementation of meaningful improvements to employee technology workflows — onboarding, offboarding, device lifecycle, access provisioning with scalability at the forefront.
  • Day-to-day operational ownership of Posit's enterprise AI platform and its supporting integrations, including SSO/SCIM health, license management, desktop deployment via MDM, and front-line support for complex issues.
  • Technical mentorship of IT Engineers — pairing on tickets, reviewing pull requests, and leveling up the team's technical practices.
  • Maintenance of SaaS configurations, end user device controls, system access controls, and patch management according to approved guidelines, with a high bar for security and compliance.
  • Creation and upkeep of technical documentation, runbooks, and playbooks for the systems and processes you own.
  • Leading scheduled audits of IT-controlled systems and coordinating remediation of findings.
  • Driving IT's GitOps practice forward — managing meaningful portions of your owned systems through version-controlled code, pull requests, and peer review, and coaching others through the same workflow.

You will assist with:

  • Defining and refining IT's engineering standards, including IaC patterns, code review expectations, and exception processes.
  • Contributing to procurement, vendor evaluation, and technical assessments for new tools — with a clear eye toward automation, support for configuration as code, and integration with our existing stack.
  • Enforcing procedures for safeguarding information security and safety within IT procedures.
  • Tracking hardware/software assets (licenses, warranties, accounts); identifying capacity and spending trends before they become problems.
  • Responding to internal and external audit requests in partnership with GRC and Security.
  • Operating and supporting the rollout of approved MCP integrations and AI workflows built by IT Engineering — owning the identity, access, deployment, and monitoring layers they depend on.
  • Recommending and implementing IT process improvements, with a bias toward automation over manual toil.

About you:

  • You have significant progressive IT experience, with meaningful time spent as a system administrator or engineer in a SaaS-first or distributed environment.
  • You thrive on solving problems through investigation and deductive reasoning, and you know when to escalate, when to dig in, and when to step back and redesign.
  • You invest in strong relationships with your colleagues and employ empathy when working through their technical issues. You can translate complex technical topics for non-technical audiences, and you can hold your own with security, engineering, and legal stakeholders.
  • You are self-driven, demonstrate initiative, and maintain a high degree of professional conduct at all times.
  • You are highly ethical, possess excellent decision-making capabilities, and execute good time management skills.
  • You question assumptions, drive change to mitigate potential risks, and possess excellent documentation skills.
  • You have deep working knowledge of corporate technologies — identity providers, MDM platforms, productivity suites, and endpoint security tooling — platforms such as Okta, Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, Fleet, Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom.
  • You are highly proficient with multiple versions of macOS, Linux, and Windows operating systems and have hands-on experience administering mobile device management platforms at scale (platforms such as Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, or Fleet).
  • You have strong working knowledge of authentication and authorization protocols (SAML, OIDC, SCIM), MFA/SSO architectures, and common identity threats.
  • Experience in meeting goals in a fast-paced environment with rapidly evolving needs, including ownership of cross-functional projects from planning through delivery.
  • You have technical working knowledge and experience administering multiple SaaS applications at scale.
  • Experience managing infrastructure in AWS (compute, networking, IAM, backups, and monitoring) is a plus — while most of our stack is SaaS, IT Operations also hosts and manages self-hosted platforms in AWS.
  • Hands-on experience with GitOps practices for IT Operations — version control, pull request workflows, and Infrastructure-as-Code platforms such as Pulumi or Terraform — or demonstrated ability to get there quickly with prior scripting/automation experience.
  • Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude Enterprise, and an understanding of how SSO, SCIM, MDM, and integration platforms combine to operate AI systems safely at scale.

Within 3 months, you'll…

  • Complete all HR and IT onboarding processes, familiarizing yourself with Posit's IT systems, security practices, and communication channels.
  • Familiarize yourself with Posit products, departments, and strategic goals.
  • Build working relationships with key stakeholders across IT Engineering, Security, GRC, and CloudOps.
  • Conduct a thorough review of existing IT documentation, tooling, and processes, and surface your first round of observations and recommendations.
  • Independently resolve complex end-user support escalations and begin taking over operational responsibility for at least one core IT system.
  • Review and contribute to existing GitOps codebases, starting with small, low-risk changes to get comfortable with the workflow.

Within 6 months, you'll…

  • Own end-to-end operations for at least one core IT platform, including its security posture, integrations, and roadmap.
  • Lead the design and rollout of at least one significant operational improvement — an automation, a new integration, a process simplification — with measurable impact.
  • Actively participate in, and help run, hardware logistics, onboarding, and offboarding workflows.
  • Mentor IT Engineers, pairing on tickets and reviewing their work.
  • Drive meaningful portions of your owned system(s) into Infrastructure-as-Code, making routine changes via pull request rather than console.
  • Act as a senior technical responder for enterprise AI platform and MCP-related incidents and escalations.

Within 12 months, you'll…

  • Be recognized across the organization as the go-to owner for your core platforms, consistently delivering on operational KPIs (uptime, MTTR, audit readiness, license utilization).
  • Have led at least one cross-functional IT project from planning through delivery, working with Security, GRC, and Engineering counterparts.
  • Have shaped IT's engineering standards and playbooks — authored or significantly contributed to key runbooks, ADRs, and shared code.
  • Play a lead role in audits and compliance activities for the systems you own, with clean findings and automated evidence where possible.
  • Be a trusted mentor for more junior team members and a visible champion of GitOps, documentation-as-code, and automation-over-toil inside IT.
  • Help plan and deliver the ongoing evolution of Posit's enterprise AI platform — platform readiness for new MCP integrations shipped by IT Engineering, governance improvements, and end-user enablement.

Posit offers competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This hiring range reflects base salary and assumes that the job will be performed in the United States.

Hiring Range
$120,600—$159,170 USD

Working at Posit:

  • We welcome all talented colleagues and are committed to a culture that represents diversity in all its forms.
  • We prioritize giving ourselves “focus time” to get deep work done. We minimize meetings and attempt to operate asynchronously.
  • We are a learning organization and take mentorship and career growth seriously. We hope to learn from you and we anticipate that you will also deepen your skills, influence, and leadership as a result of working at Posit.
  • We operate under a unique sustainable business model: We have over 50% of our engineering dedicated to creating free and open source software. We are profitable and we plan to be around decades from now.
  • Posit is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a Certified B Corporation®, which means our open-source mission is codified into our charter. As a result, our corporate decisions balance the community's interests, customers, employees, and shareholders. Hear more about why we think this matters here.

Notable:

We offer competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. These benefits apply to full-time positions only.

  • 100% of medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums are covered for employees and their families! Fertility and gender-affirming healthcare is included in all of our plans.
  • Supplemental mental health and wellness benefits are available via Ginger even if you don’t opt in to our insurance plans, including Ginger for teen family members.
  • Posit's gender-neutral paid parental leave policy covers all new parents, including foster and adoptive parents.
  • All full-time employees are eligible for 401k enrollment starting on day one.
    • After six months of employment, Posit provides a substantial yearly match to employee 401K contributions.
  • An annual profit-sharing bonus for employees recognizes our team’s contributions to company performance across the year.
  • We are a 100% distributed team. You are also welcome to come into our Boston office.
    • We offer a $400 monthly reimbursement for coworking space rental if you prefer to work away from home.
  • Our Lifestyle Savings Account offers an initial deposit of $1800 and then an additional quarterly stipend of $375 to cover the costs of professional development, wellness, financial health, charitable giving, and remote work support.
  • We provide a flexible environment with a generous vacation policy that encourages a minimum of four weeks PTO per year plus 15 paid company holidays.

Are you excited about this role but not sure if your experience aligns with every qualification in the job description? That’s okay. We know multiple perspectives are essential for a thriving organization and we'd still love to hear from you!

Posit is committed to being a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applicants of different backgrounds, cultures, genders, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, or length of time spent unemployed.
