jobs.excerpt: The future of aerospace and defense starts here.  Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch.
jobs.description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

As a Staff Loads and Dynamics Analysis Engineer, you will primarily focus on load development across vehicles and propulsion systems. Your secondary focus will either be Global Finite Element Modeling or GN&C. You will be exposed to multiple vehicles, systems, and engines, along with the unique challenges each present. We are looking for experienced analysts who bring new skills and best practices from their prior experience to Ursa and who, in time, will mentor others. You will be expected to lead verification and validation efforts and to provide proactive feedback to our design team based on the results of your work. Lastly, as Ursa ramps up its production rate and begins development on new engine platforms, you will be expected to assess nonconforming hardware, introduce approaches that could improve our team’s efficiency, and potentially venture into engine stress analysis to support others in our multi-disciplinary analysis team. You will report to our Propulsion Analysis Team Lead.

Responsibilities:

  • You will perform loads development for vehicles and engine programs
  • You will lead load spectrum development for service life assessment
  • You will perform vehicle dynamics analysis
  • You will verify and validate your models
  • You will work closely with our test team to request the instrumentation necessary to anchor our analytical models
  • You will support GFEM development for vehicles and propulsion systems
  • You will propagate loads to vehicle and engine components
  • You will collaborate with other engineering teams to develop our systems while ensuring they meet requirements and comply with the structural standards we follow
  • You will collaborate with our manufacturing team to assess nonconforming hardware for development and flight components and provide recommended dispositions and repairs
  • You will improve our analytical methods and seek out new approaches and tools
  • You will provide professional development, mentorship, and technical guidance to peers

Minimum Experience/Requirements:

  • B.S. degree in mechanical, aerospace engineering, or a comparable field
  • 8+ years of experience performing L&D analysis
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup environment
  • Expertise in dynamic analysis methods (structural dynamics, dynamic loads, acoustics , modal, random vibration, shock response)
  • Working experience in loads development for vehicle and/or engine applications
  • Experience anchoring analytical models to physical testing

Ideal Experience/Requirements:

  • M.S. degree or higher in Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a comparable field, ideally focusing on solid mechanics, fatigue, fracture, or structural dynamics
  • Experience with flutter analysis
  • GFEM development and model grounding experience
  • Knowledge of turbomachinery-related analytical methods (e.g., generating Campbell diagrams to assess margins on rotordynamics or structural modes or rotating hardware).
  • High Cycle Fatigue Analysis (HCF, crack initiation predicted by a stress-life / SN approach)
  • Low Cycle Fatigue Analysis (LCF, crack initiation predicted by a strain-life / e-N approach)
  • Experience performing Finite Element Analysis (FEA / FEM) using commercial codes (e.g., ANSYS, Abaqus, or NASTRAN-based solvers)
  • Experience with Femap/Nastran
  • Fracture analysis (crack growth / safe-life and assessing for instability via LEFM, ideally with prior experience using NASGRO)
  • Experience with the ANSYS FEA suite
  • A strong theoretical background in heat transfer, fluid mechanics, and/or compressible flow
  • Prior experience working on safety-critical systems in production environments
  • Prior professional experience working on either rocketry or turbomachinery
  • Experience supporting failure investigations and root-cause analysis
  • A track record of working efficiently in fast-paced engineering environments
  • A track record of effective oral and written communications to support your recommendations
  • Thermal-Structural static analysis (particularly dealing with nonlinear materials and large strains
  • Fluid analysis (e.g. Computational Fluid Dynamics / CFD or 1-D transient analysis using SINDA/FLUINT or ROCETS)
  • Knowledge of composite materials, insulation, and ablative thermal protection systems

 

Colorado law requires us to tell you the base compensation range of this role, which is $140,000 - $170,000, determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. What we can’t quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

Classification: Full-time Exempt

Benefits Include: (Please note, Interns are not eligible for benefits)

  • Unlimited PTO - Vacation, Sick, Personal, and Bereavement
  • Paid Parental and Adoptive Leave
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Tax Advantage Accounts (HSA/FSA)
  • Employer Paid Short and Long Term Disability, Basic Life, AD&D
  • Additional Benefit Options Including Voluntary Life and Emergency Medical Transport

Turnkey is developer-first infrastructure for private key management, making it simple to create wallets, sign transactions, and automate on-chain actions through one elegant API, without ever exposing sensitive key material. Our team is low-ego, high-agency, and high-autonomy, with a significant amount of combined experience in cryptography, security, and low-level systems. We're building the trustless, programmable infrastructure that will power the next wave of mass-market crypto applications and we're looking for people who want to shape what that future looks like.

We are looking for a crypto-native engineer to join our Transaction Management team. This team is at the heart of what Turnkey does, building the systems that orchestrate transactions and read onchain state across a wide range of blockchain protocols.   • Experience working with AWS, GCP, or other cloud providers

  • Experience building and operating large-scale, mission-critical infrastructure

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Apollo is on a mission to make world class GTM accessible for everyone. Apollo is best known for it’s world class data business, but what we’ve built goes beyond just data. The company's biggest unlock right now is closing the gap between what most people know us for today and the AI-first business we’re building.

We're hiring a Senior Content Marketing Manager to own that gap. You'll work with Apollo’s exec team to build narratives that break through the noise to position Apollo as the default AI native system for GTM teams. You’ll also own operationalizing that narrative by owning the content strategy that gets this narrative into market - long form research based content, exec thought leadership, and proof points that shift how the market sees us. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with our CEO, CRO, CMO, and product PMMs.

This is a senior IC role for an experienced product marketer who's just as comfortable writing the LinkedIn post as building the messaging house behind it. If you've ever been the person quietly translating an exec's half-formed idea into the narrative everyone ends up repeating — this role is built for you.

What You'll Do

  • Drive the perception shift. Build and execute the strategy that moves Apollo to "AI-first GTM platform" in the minds of upmarket buyers, analysts, and the broader GTM community.
  • Run the company content engine. Set the editorial POV, prioritize the bets, and ship the work — original research, defining frameworks, exec thought leadership, blog flagships, video, podcast moments. You're as much an editor as a writer.
  • Operationalize narrative into launches. Partner with product PMMs to map product to narrative, so every Tier 1/2 launch lands in the larger story instead of as a one-off feature drop.
  • Translate technical into magnetic. Take dense product capability (MCP, agents, the platform architecture) and turn it into stories upmarket buyers, operators, and analysts can't stop quoting.
  • Build the proof point machine. Partner with customer marketing to turn customer wins, usage data, and category benchmarks into the evidence layer behind every narrative claim.
  • Scale yourself with AI. Fluency with Claude (and the workflows we've built around it) is required. You should be the kind of PMM who treats AI as core infrastructure, not a side tool.
  • Measure the vibe shift. Brand pulse, Gong call language, analyst conversations, inbound demand signal — track the perception KPIs alongside content performance.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of content marketing experience at B2B SaaS, with a clear spike in narrative, positioning, and content. Strong content marketers with deep PMM chops also welcome — but this role lives in the PMM seat.
  • You write. Not "can write when needed" — you write. You have a portfolio of long-form, exec social, narrative docs, or launch copy you'd put on a billboard. You can make a CEO sound like the smartest version of themselves.
  • Cross-functional translator. You're the connective tissue between product, sales, brand, comms, and exec — you've worked directly with CEOs and CROs and you know how to turn their instincts into shipped artifacts.
  • Strong POV on AI go-to-market. You don't need to be an AI doomer or zealot, but you have a real take on how AI is reshaping B2B GTM, and you've started showing it through your own work.
  • AI-native operator. Comfortable with Claude as a daily tool; you've built or used custom skills, prompts, or workflows that meaningfully scale your output. Bonus for AirOps, Tofu, Opus Clip, or anything beyond ChatGPT.
  • Builder mentality. Comfortable shipping V1 docs, running point on cross-functional asks, and saying no to kitchen-sink PMM requests. You've worked in environments where you set the system, not inherit it.
  • Distribution sensibility. You think about how a narrative spreads — through exec voice, influencer networks, analyst conversations, owned channels — not just what you're publishing.
  • High agency, high bar. You can move from C-suite narrative work to writing a LinkedIn post for a launch in the same day, and you hold yourself and your partners to a tight quality bar.

Bonus Points

  • You've worked at a company that successfully shifted upmarket — and you can tell the story of what marketing actually did to make that happen.
  • You've gone viral in the B2B space — but you also know that virality without narrative is noise.

Why This Role

  • High-leverage moment. Apollo is at the rare inflection point where the product, the market, and the AI shift have all aligned — and narrative is the missing piece. The right person here directly influences how the next phase of the company is perceived.
  • Strong scaffolding, room to lead. Brand, copywriting, social, web, customer marketing, and product PMM are all in place. You won't be a one-person band — you'll be the strategist who pulls it together.
  • Direct access to execs. You'll work directly with our CEO, CRO, and CMO on the questions that matter most to the business.

jobs.excerpt: We're transforming the grocery industryAt Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together.
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Search & Personalization ML team is Instacart’s engine for state-of-the-art multi-task, multi-objective ranking—unifying search, discovery, recommendation, ads, and merchandising into a single value-aware platform. Partnering with world-class engineers, scientists, and PMs, we build the ranking backbone that powers every pixel of the shopping journey, optimizing not just for clicks, but for incremental GTV, basket lift, and retention over the long run.

What We’re Building

  • Foundational Ranking Backbone Models: Multi-task/multi-objective models (shared encoders + task heads) that jointly learn relevance, conversion, margin contribution, churn risk, and ad quality, enabling consistent decisions across search and recommendations.
  • Value-Aware Optimization: Uplift and long-horizon value models that steer decisions toward incrementality and LTV, with calibrated constraints on quality, diversity, fairness, and spend pacing—plus guardrails for safe exploration.
  • LLM-Enhanced Retrieval & Features: Using LLMs to enrich query and item semantics for long-tail recall, generate features for cold-starts, and feed the ranker with reasoning-rich context, while remaining the source of truth for final ordering.

Our commitment to AI innovation is reflected in our recent publications and research contributions to the field.

About the Job

  • Architect the ranking backbone that unifies query understanding, personalization, multi-objective ranking, ads, and merchandising into a single adaptive platform.
  • Design and build a search autosuggest system optimized for personalization and value-based relevance.
  • Design long-horizon objective functions (e.g., incrementality, LTV, habit formation) and build uplift/causal value models that move beyond short-term engagement.
  • Develop production-grade Multi-Task Learning (e.g., shared encoders, MMOE/PLE task heads) to jointly learn relevance, propensity, margin, and churn risk—ensuring calibration, constraints, and explainability.
  • Own the inference layer: goal-aware re-rankers, diversity and quality constraints, safe exploration, and millisecond-class latency optimization.
  • Advance evaluation practices: online experiments, long-horizon cohort metrics, counterfactual evaluations, and attribution pipelines for tracking incremental GTV and retention.
  • Partner across ads, infrastructure, product, and design teams to translate business goals into ranking policies and measurable ROI.
  • Mentor ML engineers to build expertise in ranking, causal inference, and scalable serving systems.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years applying ML at scale (3+ years in technical leadership), with a proven track record improving ranking or recommendation systems in production.
  • Demonstrated success in applying multi-objective or constrained optimization to balance relevance, revenue, margin, and user experience; experience with online testing and attribution beyond CTR.
  • Strong coding (Python) and data fluency (SQL/Pandas), with expertise in classic ML techniques (e.g., XGBoost) and deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow/PyTorch).
  • Excellent analytical skills and strong cross-functional communication abilities.\
  • Graduate degree (Masters or PhD) in machine learning, statistics, computer science, information retrieval, or a closely related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Expertise in multi-task learning architectures (e.g., MMOE/PLE, shared encoders), calibration, counterfactual evaluation, uplift/causal modeling, and/or contextual bandits for exploration.
  • Experience building low-latency ranking services, including feature stores, caching, vector + lexical retrieval, re-ranking, and A/B testing infrastructure, with expertise in constraint-aware inference.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs as feature/recall enhancers (e.g., embeddings, adapter tuning) while maintaining clarity on when the ranker should arbitrate.

jobs.description:
Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.
  • You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy. Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.
  • You want to work with a product customers love. People rave about what we’ve built. Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.
  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.

What’s this role about?

We’re looking for a Director of Channel Sales to accelerate and scale Auvik’s partner ecosystem.

This is a high-impact leadership role focused on building on the strong foundation already in place, evolving our partner program, expanding strategic partnerships, and driving meaningful partner-sourced and influenced revenue.

You will operate at both a strategic and operational level, partnering cross-functionally while establishing the structure, discipline, and execution model required to scale channel into a consistent and predictable growth engine.

What will I be doing?

Channel Strategy & Growth

  • Define and execute Auvik’s channel go-to-market strategy to drive scalable growth
  • Identify and prioritize key partner segments (MSPs, VARs, distributors, strategic alliances)
  • Expand Auvik’s presence within high-impact partners and ecosystems
  • Own partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, driving co-selling motions to improve velocity and win rates

Partner Program & Performance

  • Build and evolve the partner program to improve scalability, clarity, and engagement
  • Align partner tiers, incentives, and models to support growth objectives
  • Track and optimize performance based on pipeline, conversion, and partner contribution

Team & Organizational Leadership

  • Define and scale the channel coverage model aligned to growth targets
  • Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team of partner managers
  • Foster a performance-driven culture focused on execution and results

Strategic Partnerships & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Build and manage executive-level relationships with key partners
  • Deepen partnerships to unlock new revenue streams and market opportunities
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Product to align on go-to-market strategy and partner enablement
  • Ensure partners are effectively integrated into Auvik’s broader revenue motion

Operational Scale

  • Establish clear operating rhythms and accountability across the channel
  • Define and track key performance metrics across pipeline, conversion, and partner contribution
  • Improve systems, processes, and workflows to reduce friction and increase efficiency
  • Bring structure and predictability to how Auvik scales its channel business

What are we looking for?

  • Experience leading or scaling channel, partnerships, or indirect go-to-market motions within a SaaS environment
  • A track record of driving measurable revenue impact through partners, not just building programs
  • Strong understanding of MSP, VAR, and distribution models, and how to prioritize across them
  • Experience building or evolving partner programs to support growth and engagement
  • Experience leading or developing partner-facing teams, or clear readiness to step into that leadership scope
  • Comfort operating in a high-growth environment where not everything is fully defined—you can bring structure without slowing things down
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across teams and at senior levels externally
  • A data-driven approach to managing performance, pipeline, and partner contribution

Are there bonus points?

  • Experience working in or selling into MSP or IT service provider ecosystems
  • Background in scaling channel motions at a company going through rapid growth
  • Experience building co-selling frameworks that meaningfully impact win rates and deal velocity

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.

About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

We use AI tools to support administrative tasks in the hiring process; such as helping source candidates, drafting communications, and interview summaries, so our team can stay focused and present during conversations. We do not use AI tools to interview, screen or assess candidates; or determine who moves forward in the process. We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Auvik employees are eligible to participate in additional benefits and programs including our comprehensive health and dental benefits plan, 401k matching program, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave program, and are eligible for remote working subsidies.

jobs.excerpt: Zeal Group is an award-winning global FinTech powerhouse with 700+ professionals across London, Europe, Asia, MENA, and South America.
jobs.description:
Zeal Group is an award-winning global FinTech powerhouse with 700+ professionals across London, Europe, Asia, MENA, and South America. Through our subsidiary Traze, we deliver advanced multi-asset trading solutions across Gold, Oil, FX, Indices, and Cryptocurrencies, built for today’s fast-moving, high-volatility markets.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Quantitative Analyst to own the technical and analytical backbone of our trading risk and fraud function. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role — not a management position. You will design, build, and maintain the systems that detect toxic flow, latency arbitrage, and abusive trading behavior, and you will use that technology yourself to investigate, classify, and act on risk. You'll report to the Head of Risk, working with a high degree of autonomy and minimal oversight.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience and strong foundation with machine learning and data science in financial markets.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build the backend infrastructure, monitoring tools, and detection algorithms used to identify toxic flow, latency arbitrage, and abusive trading patterns.
  • Use the systems you build to investigate trading and non-trading activity, detect suspicious behavior, and report findings.
  • Analyze existing and new trading products and promotions for fraud/abuse exposure and propose mitigations.
  • Classify clients to support A-book/B-book decisioning and profitable execution outcomes.
  • Own end-to-end delivery: from raw data extraction and hypothesis testing through to production deployment of monitoring and alerting systems.
  • Continuously identify gaps in current processes and design new logic to increase automation and reduce manual intervention.
  • Mentor others on technical and analytical approaches as the function grows.

Requirements

Must have

  • 3+ years' experience in Quant/Trading OR FX/CFD brokerage environment, in a quantitative, risk, or analytics role.
  • Proficient experience with Python is mandatory.
  • Demonstrated experience independently building and owning production-grade tools, dashboards, or systems (not just using existing ones).
  • Can provide evidence of data science related projects, ideally end-to-end driven projects.
  • Strong knowledge of financial trading products, trading conditions, and execution mechanics.
  • Understanding of fraud/abuse patterns in trading (toxic flow, latency arbitrage, manipulation).
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Finance, or a related quantitative field.
  • Comfortable working with high ownership and low supervision; proactive and self-directed.

Preferred

  • Experience with SQL.
  • Experience or understanding of A/B-book risk models, transaction cost analysis, or execution analytics.
  • Exposure to regulatory reporting (MAR, FCA, CySEC, ASIC).
  • Track record of mentoring junior analysts.

This role suits someone who wants to build something from the ground up and use it, not just analyze data others have prepared. If you're a quant who thinks in systems, takes initiative without being asked, and wants ownership over a real risk function — this is built for you.

Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).

In this role, you will be responsible for generating new business, expanding relationships with existing customers, and serving as a trusted advisor to dealership leaders looking to modernize their operations through AI-powered solutions.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, relationship management, and strategic account growth. Success requires someone who can build strong relationships with dealership decision-makers, uncover opportunities, navigate complex sales cycles, and create long-term value for customers.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a strong hunter mentality who thrives in a highly autonomous environment and takes ownership of territory performance.   • Drive new logo acquisition through consistent prospecting, networking, referral generation, and territory development activities.
  • Create opportunities through proactive outreach and in-person engagement rather than relying solely on inbound demand.

  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline while managing opportunities through all stages of the sales process.
  • Conduct consultative discovery conversations, product demonstrations, and presentations tailored to dealership needs and business objectives.
  • Balance new business development with strategic management and expansion of existing customer relationships.
  • Manage and grow relationships with existing customers, identifying opportunities for expansion, adoption, and long-term partnership.

The team is still small and many of our bigger initiatives are at an early stage. jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

OVERVIEW

Every year, people across the world spend nearly one trillion dollars on groceries. But food is more than sustenance — it's identity, ritual, culture, and care. The way we eat shapes our health, our routines, and our relationships. Yet for most people, translating a desire to eat better or live healthier into actual, lasting habit change remains hard.

The Instacart Consumer team is at the forefront of reimagining how people relate to food at home. We're building new product experiences around meals, nutrition, and health that go beyond the transaction — helping people discover what to cook, build routines that stick, and feel confident in the choices they make for themselves and their families.

As a Staff Researcher on the Consumer team, you will shape the foundational understanding of how and why people change (or struggle to change) their food behaviors. You'll lead research that spans the full arc from generative discovery to iterative product testing, partnering closely with product, design, data science, marketing, and engineering to build products grounded in deep human insight. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for a researcher who is as comfortable in the messiness of early-stage innovation as they are in the rigor of quantitative validation.

ABOUT THE JOB

  • Independently own and drive the research roadmap for the consumer innovation workstream, partnering across product, design, data science, and engineering leadership to surface where research can shape strategy, unlock new opportunities, and push innovation
  • Lead generative, foundational research to understand how people think about food, nutrition, and health — including mental models, motivations, barriers, and behavioral triggers
  • Apply behavioral science frameworks (e.g., habit loops, nudge theory, behavior change models) to frame research questions and surface insights that fuel creative problem-solving and unlock new directions for product and design
  • Execute and oversee rigorous mixed-methods research: qualitative studies (in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation, diary studies, co-creation) alongside quantitative approaches (surveys, behavioral data analysis, concept testing at scale)
  • Translate research into compelling, actionable narratives that move stakeholders to decisions, from early-stage opportunity framing to product launch validation
  • Own and evolve the team's understanding of the consumer, maintaining living knowledge bases, personas, and journey maps that the broader organization draws on
  • Mentor junior researchers and contribute to the craft, culture, and standards of the Instacart research organization
  • Be a visible advocate for the customer across the organization, influencing roadmap and strategy through the quality and clarity of insights

ABOUT YOU

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years conducting UX or consumer research in a product organization, with meaningful experience in early-stage innovation or new product development
  • Background or deep familiarity with behavioral psychology, behavioral economics, or related fields - you understand the science of how habits form, persist, and change, and you bring that lens to your work
  • Expertise across a wide range of qualitative methodologies: in-depth interviews, ethnographic and diary studies, usability testing, participatory design, and workshop facilitation
  • Equally strong with quantitative methods: survey design and analysis, behavioral data interpretation, experimental design, and synthesis across mixed-methods studies
  • Proven ability to lead foundational, generative research — going beyond feature validation to define the opportunity space and shape product strategy
  • Exceptional storyteller: you turn nuanced human insight into crisp, compelling narratives that drive alignment and action at all levels of the organization
  • Experience working with or alongside data science teams to triangulate behavioral patterns from usage data with qualitative findings
  • Track record of influencing product roadmaps, not just informing them — you know how to position research to land with impact
  • Fluency using AI tools to accelerate iterative research cycles — from faster synthesis and screener development to rapid concept testing — while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Advanced degree preferred (Psychology, Behavioral Science, Cognitive Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Anthropology, or a related field); Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, grocery, CPG, or subscription products where lifecycle, personalization, and repeat behavior are critical
  • Research experience on high-visibility consumer surfaces such as home feeds, personalized browse, and merchandising placements — including how users navigate density, information hierarchy, and above/below-the-fold content
  • Background researching and informing onboarding, activation, and retention journeys that build habits, loyalty, and trust
  • Familiarity with AI-powered, agentic, or conversational product experiences and the ability to study how users engage with them — including novel methods for researching AI interactions
  • Ability to influence outcomes on multi-team initiatives without direct authority — you know how to build the coalitions that make research land
  • Familiarity with meal planning, nutrition, health goals, or dietary restriction management and how they intersect with household grocery behavior

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Our core experience is in VR but we’re fast becoming cross-platform as we invest in mobile and move into new territories in spatial computing including wearable AI and AR glasses.   1. Final 3D character turnarounds — production quality model matching the approved concept.

  2. Expression & pose sheets — the full range of Atlas's emotional and physical vocabulary.

  4. Animations — the initial set for mobile app and UI use (final list agreed at kickoff; think idle, celebrate, encourage, react, transition states).

Position Summary

Ryan Specialty Benefits is seeking an experienced and clinically driven Clinical Risk Manager to join our dynamic Clinical Advisory Team. This is a unique opportunity to play a critical role within a rapidly growing organization that is redefining clinical risk management and stop loss cost containment.
As a Clinical Risk Manager, you will serve as a strategic clinical consultant, partnering closely with our brokers, carrier partners, TPAs, captive programs, specialty vendors, and employer-sponsored health plans to identify risk, evaluate high-cost claims, and develop innovative cost mitigation strategies. Your expertise will directly influence underwriting decisions, risk management initiatives, and financial outcomes for our clients.
This role is ideal for a clinically experienced Registered Nurse who enjoys combining clinical expertise with financial analysis, strategic problem-solving, and collaborative relationship management. You will become part of a highly engaged team focused on delivering meaningful results through clinical insights, proactive risk identification, and innovative mitigation solutions.

What will your job entail?

What You'll Do

Clinical Risk Assessment & Analysis

  • Analyze medical and pharmacy claims, clinical records, treatment plans, and emerging therapies to identify high-cost claim exposure and stop loss risk.
  • Evaluate current and future claim liabilities, including complex cases involving oncology, transplants, specialty pharmacy, gene and cell therapy, catastrophic claims, and chronic conditions.
  • Assess clinical severity, treatment patterns, and emerging risks to support stop loss underwriting and risk management decisions.

Cost Projection & Financial Modeling

  • Develop accurate clinical cost projections for high-dollar claimants and complex cases.
  • Monitor significant ongoing claims and identify potential changes in risk exposure.
  • Provide detailed financial analyses and forecasting that support underwriting, renewal, captive, and carrier decision-making.

Risk Mitigation Strategy Development

  • Partner with brokers, carriers, TPAs, case management teams, specialty vendors, and employer groups to identify opportunities for cost containment and risk reduction.
  • Evaluate and recommend clinical and financial mitigation solutions, including:
    • Specialty pharmacy optimization
    • Biosimilar conversion opportunities
    • Site-of-care management
    • Centers of Excellence utilization
    • Case management intervention
    • Transplant management programs
    • Gene and cell therapy solutions
    • Alternative funding and assistance programs
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to implement effective cost-management strategies that improve outcomes while controlling plan spend.

Captive and Client Support

  • Support captive risk management initiatives through ongoing clinical reviews and risk assessments.
  • Present complex clinical information in a concise, actionable manner for clients, brokers, captives, carrier partners, and executive leadership.
  • Serve as a trusted clinical resource during renewal discussions, prospect evaluations, and risk management consultations.

Collaboration & Relationship Management

  • Work closely with Ryan Specialty Benefits consultants, producers, underwriting partners, TPAs, brokers, carriers, and specialty vendors.
  • Foster strong strategic relationships that support innovative client solutions and exceptional service delivery.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary discussions to identify trends, share best practices, and improve overall risk management outcomes.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate documentation of clinical analyses, cost projections, and mitigation recommendations.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and executive summaries that communicate clinical risk and financial impact to diverse audiences.
  • Monitor outcomes and effectiveness of implemented mitigation strategies.

Qualifications

Education

  • Associate's or Bachelor's Degree in Nursing or a related healthcare field preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical nursing experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years of stop loss captive risk management required.
  • Experience evaluating complex and catastrophic claims strongly preferred.

Licensure

  • Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license.

Ryan Specialty is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building and sustaining a diverse workforce throughout the organization. Our vision is an inclusive and equitable workplace where all employees are valued for and evaluated on their performance and contributions. Differences in race, creed, color, religious beliefs, physical or mental capabilities, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, and many other characteristics bring together varied perspectives and add value to the service we provide our clients, trading partners, and communities. At Fluency, we come together under two shared passions that drive our culture: the scaling of digital ad operations, and fostering a workplace environment rooted in open communication, inclusivity, and a growth-oriented mindset. Job Summary

The VP of Engineering is a strategic executive leader responsible for the long-term technical vision, organizational health, and scalable architecture of the Fluency platform. This role moves beyond day-to-day tactical ownership to focus on building high-leverage organizational structures, cross-functional alignment at the executive level, and a platform foundation that supports massive customer growth without proportional increases in technical debt. Crucially, this leader brings a proven track record of designing and executing large-scale system implementations within the high-volume advertising technology (Ad-Tech) or digital advertising ecosystem to fuel our next phase of scale.

Key Executive Responsibilities

  • Executive Strategy & Influence: Partner with the CTO and C-Suite to define the long-term engineering roadmap and ensure continuous alignment with overarching company strategy and platform stability requirements.
  • Organizational Architecture: Continuously refine and oversee the engineering organizational structure (e.g., Squad model) to ensure directors and leads are empowered to operate independently, preventing the VP from becoming a tactical constraint.
  • Platform Resilience & Ad-Tech Scale: Maintain and evolve the strategic architectural direction of the Fluency platform—particularly blending our cellular/isolated database architecture with the high-concurrency, low-latency requirements characteristic of large-scale advertising systems. Ensure robust resilience under massive data volumes for hundreds of enterprise customers.
  • Experimentation Framework: Define and enforce engineering standards and clear operational boundaries between experimental product R&D (Labs) and stable core engineering to safeguard platform integrity.
  • Remote Leadership Excellence: Lead and foster a high-performance, geographically distributed remote engineering culture, ensuring seamless communication, accountability, and operational excellence across all time zones.
  • Talent Strategy: Develop and manage the long-term talent strategy, overseeing hiring, professional development pipelines, and succession planning to ensure staffing aligns with future technical and business needs.

What We Look For

  • Strategic Visionary: A leader who can articulate the business impact of technical debt and infrastructure investments to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Systems Thinker: Proven ability to build "systems of people" that solve complex problems without needing direct executive intervention.
  • Ad-Tech Scale Expertise: Deep operational understanding of high-throughput distributed systems, heavy data pipeline mechanics, and ecosystem integrations unique to the advertising world.
  • Crisis Management Executive: Ability to remain calm and decisive during high-stakes incidents while simultaneously building the frameworks to prevent their recurrence.
  • Executive Presence: Comfortable navigating organizational resistance and building compelling business cases for modernization.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in engineering leadership.
  • 5+ years of engineering leadership experience specifically within the advertising industry (Ad-Tech, Mar-Tech, or high-volume digital media platforms), successfully delivering large-scale system implementations.
  • Proven track record of scaling a SaaS platform through significant revenue and customer growth.
  • Experience managing multiple managers or directors in a squad-based or departmental structure.
  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered development tools and their impact on engineering productivity.

Fluency pays all employees based on U.S. nationwide averages for each role, designed to ensure pay equity. This is a full-time, remote position that requires legal authorization to work in the U.S. Starting pay range is determined by job-related skills, experience, and knowledge. The role is also eligible for a discretionary bonus, equity options, and a comprehensive benefits package including:

jobs.excerpt: A highly skilled and experienced Senior Cost Control Manager will oversee the management of large-scale construction and infrastructure project budgets from inception to completion.
jobs.description:
A highly skilled and experienced Senior Cost Control Manager will oversee the management of large-scale construction and infrastructure project budgets from inception to completion. This senior-level position will be responsible for ensuring financial discipline, effective cost control, and alignment with project and organizational objectives. This position will work closely with internal and external project teams, vendors, cost consultants, finance, and accounting teams to ensure project costs are accurately forecasted, tracked, and maintained. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of construction contracts, change management processes, and financial systems, along with the ability to lead teams and drive cost-effective solutions across multiple complex projects.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leadership & Team Development: Lead and mentor onsite cost team. Provide direction for strict adherence to cost control processes and ensure alignment across the project management teams. Foster a collaborative environment to ensure seamless execution of cost management strategies.
  • Project Budget Oversight: Manage and oversee the creation and validation of project budgets for large-scale construction and infrastructure projects. Monitor financial performance through all stages of the project lifecycle, ensuring adherence to budget constraints and identifying potential areas for cost savings.
  • Contract & Change Order Management: Thoroughly review construction contract documents and assess potential change orders. Lead the process of evaluating and approving change orders, ensuring that cost implications are accurately assessed, documented, and communicated to project stakeholders. Oversee the management of internal approval workflows for change orders in accordance with established delegation of authority protocols.
  • Cost Analysis & Forecasting: Evaluate contractors’ requests and conduct in-depth analysis of cost forecasts, including cash flow projections, monthly progress payments, and variance reporting. Reconcile actual expenditures against project budgets and provide timely, actionable insights to senior leadership to ensure projects remain on track financially.
  • Vendor & Subcontractor Management: Lead and review the procurement process, ensuring that subcontractor and vendor contracts align with the project budget and contractual terms. Monitor buyout savings and assess any financial risks posed by subcontractor performance, recommending adjustments as necessary.
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary financial liaison between the project teams, contractors, subcontractors, finance department, and external consultants. Facilitate regular meetings to ensure all stakeholders are informed of project financial performance, potential risks, and change order status.
  • Financial Reporting & Documentation: Provide detailed and accurate cost reports, including cash flow analysis, monthly financial reviews, and projections. Support the finance team in the monthly loan draw process, ensuring that all required documentation is obtained and accurate.
  • Risk Management & Compliance: Assess and mitigate cost-related risks, ensuring all project costs remain within the approved budget. Ensure compliance with relevant financial regulations, internal policies, and construction contract terms.
  • Mentorship & Knowledge Transfer: Lead internal training and mentorship initiatives to develop cost control capabilities within the team. Share best practices, lessons learned, and industry insights to promote continuous improvement in cost management processes.
  • Third-Party Oversight: Manage third-party cost auditing teams and consultants, ensuring that all external parties align with the project's financial objectives and contractual obligations.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, financing, or accounting; or relevant professional experience.
  • Ten or more years of experience in cost control, construction, or project management with prior experience in a senior or leadership role.
  • Deep expertise in construction contract documents, change management, and budget control processes.
  • Advanced proficiency in financial and project management software (e.g., Workday, e-Builder, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud).
  • Proven ability to provide detailed and accurate financial forecasts, track project costs, and manage budgets through all stages of a project lifecycle.
  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and present recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree or professional certifications such as PMP, CCP, or similar are a plus.
  • Ten or more years of experience in cost control, construction, or project management preferably overseeing large-scale construction or infrastructure projects in a senior or leadership role.
  • Three or more years of experience in a leadership or management role.
  • Advanced knowledge of industry-specific regulations and best practices in cost control.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Strong leadership skills with a track record of managing teams, fostering collaboration, and driving performance improvement.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, contractors, and third-party consultants.
  • Strong problem solving and decision-making capabilities in fast paced environment.

TOTAL REWARDS

This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company benefits. This role is bonus eligible and may be eligible for equity.

The reliability and test engineer is responsible for environmental testing , reliability characterisation, and other V&V test activities that result in product or process improvements, you will be making a key contribution to optimizing our designs for manufacturability and reliability.

The role has responsibilities such as:

  • Determining appropriate reliability testing requirements for products; review product requirement specifications to develop sub-assembly or system-level test plans.
  • Developing and executing to our schedules for Reliability and V&V testing of products. Testing for reliability includes regulatory pre-compliance and lifetime, including transportation – drop, shock, and vibration, long-term operating life, (HALT and HTOL – high temperature high humidity), thermal cycling, mechanical wear-out tests, etc.
  • Taking ownership of test processes: creating test protocols, setup of test apparatus, execution of tests, analysis of data, and preparation of technical reports.
  • Applying Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, or other statistical methods to identify failure patterns and assist in the elimination of defects.

  • Developing test fixtures including Electro- and Opto- mechanical elements.
  • Troubleshooting of problems with units under test or with the test tools – software, fixtures, and instrumentation.
  • Analysis of unit failures; Identify problems in design or manufacturing and assist with the implementation of solutions.

Outcomes of testing will elicit any points of failure or modes of performance degradation, this will inform improvements, and will ultimately demonstrate that Cylite products are able to survive for their expected service life and comply with the product qualification criteria - as specified in regulatory testing standards (such as IEC60601 or ISTA Safe Transit testing).

Required Skills / Education / Attributes:

  • Qualifications in Engineering or Science.
  • More than 3 years’ experience in the testing of mechanical and electronic systems in a reliability driven environment, such as product testing, qualification, or development (any prior work with either Optical or Medical Devices would be highly regarded).

  • Experience with regulatory testing and of international testing standards and specifications i.e. ISO/IEC, ISTA, etc.

  • Literacy with Solidworks 3D and can read drawings of opto- and electro- mechanical systems.
  • Optics or Medical device experience.
  • Knowledge of LabVIEW or Python programming for control and automated data acquisition.

Job Title: Indirect Contracting Team Leader (f/m/d) Pharmaceutical Diagnostics

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

As the Indirect Contracting Team Leader (f/m/d), you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end management of indirect customer contracts across PDx International. You will lead a team of contract specialists and ensure that distributor, wholesaler and sales representative contracts are in place, effectively managed, renewed on time, and fully compliant with applicable laws, regulations, and internal GE HealthCare policies.

This role is critical in strengthening and sustaining the indirect contracting control environment across PDx International. It requires strong contract management expertise, sound judgment, people leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to drive transformation in a complex, cross-functional environment. The role will focus on standard work, lean processes, measurable performance management, governance, and sustainable remediation of contract lifecycle risks.

The role is responsible for operational contract lifecycle management and governance. Legal interpretation, advice, risk assessments, and approval of substantive contractual deviations remain the responsibility of the Legal function. The same applies to PDx Compliance.

The role is open for hybrid, remote, or onsite set-up in any European country.

At GE HealthCare, our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. That’s because we never lose sight of what healthcare really needs—the human touch.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

Indirect Contract Management:

  • Lead the end-to-end operational management of the contract life cycle for distributor, wholesaler and sales representative contracts. This will include drafting, review, execution, renewal, amendment, extension, and termination in close coordination with particularly Commercial, Regulatory, Quality, Pharmacovigilance, Legal and Compliance teams.
  • Ensure contract coverage, expiry dates, status, renewal timelines, key obligations, comprehensive and accurate contract repository, and remediation actions are accurately tracked, maintained, and audit-ready.
  • Identify indirect third parties operating without valid contract coverage and drive risk-based remediation, including prioritization of expired or at-risk contracts.
  • Partner with Commercial, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders to manage customers without valid contract coverage according to agreed controls, escalation pathways, ordering restrictions, and documentation requirements.
  • Ensure compliant execution and lifecycle management of third-party commercial contracts by enforcing approved templates, completing required due diligence and compliance reviews, and coordinating necessary legal, regulatory, trade compliance, privacy, competition law, and anti-corruption assessments. Ensure timely escalation of material risks, deviations, and approval requirements in accordance with company policies and applicable regulations.
  • Decision-making authority includes operational prioritization of contract renewals and team workload, workflow management, governance reporting, escalation of identified risks, and driving process improvements in alignment with relevant support functions. Approval of contractual deviations, policy exceptions, and legal or compliance positions remains with the designated approving functions.

Team Leadership and Operational Execution:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of contract specialists, ensuring clear priorities, high-quality execution, and consistent ways of working.
  • Set expectations for process adherence, documentation quality, stakeholder responsiveness, compliance with internal standards, and Daily Management.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex contracting topics, lapsed coverage, renewal prioritization, delays, deviations, and cross-functional alignment needs.
  • Train and build team capability and foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Compliance, Risk Management and Governance:

  • Ensure indirect customer contracts comply with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, SOPs, approval requirements, and GE HealthCare compliance standards.
  • Strengthen the contracting control environment through contract coverage, renewal governance, role clarity, process adherence, and effective risk escalation.
  • Define and maintain clear roles and responsibilities, including RACI for contract review, approval, renewal, escalation, and cross-functional decision-making.
  • Establish governance routines to review overdue actions, upcoming renewals, lapsed coverage, extensions, deviations, risks, process adherence, audit readiness, and remediation progress.
  • Support internal investigations, audit activities, compliance reviews, and management responses relating to indirect contracting activities.

Process Transformation and Lean Standard Work:

  • Transform the indirect contracting process toward a standardized, lean, transparent, and well-controlled operating model.
  • Redesign the contract renewal lifecycle with clear initiation triggers, process maps, approval pathways, standard handoffs, and defined ownership embedding mandatory function specific review checkpoints and deviation escalation.
  • Implement standard work, templates, process documentation, operating rhythms, and Daily Management across PDx International.
  • Drive adoption of contract lifecycle management technologies, data quality standards, automation opportunities, and reporting capabilities to improve efficiency, transparency, and risk management. Continuously improve routines to increase transparency, reduce email-based follow-up, improve action ownership, and reduce waste, waiting times, rework, and complexity.

Management System, KPIs and Performance Tracking:

  • Build and maintain a management system for indirect contracting, including KPIs, dashboards, performance reviews, action tracking, and governance routines.
  • Monitor contract lifecycle performance, including contracts executed before expiry, renewal cycle duration, extensions, lapsed coverage, overdue actions, deviations, backlog, and remediation progress.
  • Use data insights to identify bottlenecks, gaps, and process failures, and translate them into prioritization, escalation, resource allocation, and improvement actions.
  • Provide regular updates on performance, contract coverage, risks, remediation actions, efficiency improvements, and transformation milestones.

Stakeholder Management and Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Build strong relationships with all relevant support functions, such as Compliance, Legal, Finance, Regulatory, Operations, Sales Managers, and regional leadership teams.
  • Align stakeholders on contracting priorities, process requirements, risk management expectations, roles and responsibilities, decision rights, and escalation points.
  • Communicate complex or sensitive contracting matters clearly and effectively, helping build consensus across functions.
  • Act as a senior point of contact for indirect contracting topics, escalations, governance discussions, remediation actions, and transformation initiatives.

Required Qualifications:

  • Significant experience in contract drafting and management, commercial contracting, legal operations, public procurement, commercial operations, or a related field, preferably within healthcare, pharmaceutical, diagnostics, medical technology, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience managing distributor networks, working within regulated healthcare, leading cross-border contracting teams, implementing governance frameworks and responding to internal or external audits is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management, distributor or indirect customer contracting, compliance requirements, risk management, internal controls, and governance frameworks within regulated healthcare.
  • Proven ability to lead a team, set priorities, drive accountability, manage operational execution, and build team capability.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead process transformation, standardization, lean initiatives, Daily Management, continuous improvement, and operational excellence programs.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to define KPIs, create performance transparency, interpret operational data, identify gaps, and drive improvement actions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to align relevant support functions, such as Compliance, Legal, Finance, Regulatory, Operations, Sales, and senior business stakeholders.
  • High attention to detail, strong organizational discipline, and commitment to quality, compliance, documentation accuracy, process adherence, and audit readiness.
  • Ability to operate with sound judgment, autonomy, and ownership while operating effectively within defined decision-making boundaries, managing competing priorities, resolving complex issues, and driving decisions across countries and functions.
  • Demonstrated experience in operating across multiple jurisdictions, cultures, and regulatory environments in a global or regional organization.
  • Proven ability to lead organizational change, influence adoption of new processes, manage resistance, and sustain behavioural change across stakeholder groups.
  • Lean, project management, process excellence, workflow transformation, or contract lifecycle system experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with contract workflows, lifecycle and the respective IT tools (such as Salesforce.com) are highly advantageous.
  • Fluent English is required. Additional languages relevant to PDx International are a plus.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally. We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications, and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the centre of an ecosystem working toward precision health – digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world.

Our Pharmaceutical Diagnostics business is the number one global supplier of contrast media and molecular imaging agents used to enhance medical imaging exams. Used throughout all major disease area diagnostic and treatment pathways, PDx products support four patients every second around the world.

If you are interested in learning more we are looking forward to your online-application!

Don't meet all the requirements? We are aware that there is almost never a perfect profile. You can learn (almost) anything as long as you are interested and enjoy new topics and challenges. In short: we look forward to receiving your application, even if you do not yet meet the requirements 100%!

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally. We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the center of an ecosystem working toward precision health - digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Senior BIM/VDC Project Manager

Remote, Full-Time (Some Travel) Exempt Reports to: Director of VDC / Operations

About Ayoroa Simmons

Ayoroa Simmons is one of the most trusted reality capture and BIM firms in the Eastern United States, with a client roster that includes some of the largest AEC organizations in the country and the U.S. Department of Defense. For over a decade, we have delivered surveying, laser scanning, Scan to BIM, and BIM/VDC services as a fully integrated offering, giving project teams the accurate existing-conditions data they need to design, build, and manage with confidence.

With a 35+ person team and a track record on complex institutional, healthcare, and infrastructure projects, we bring the scale and precision standards that this work demands. Ayoroa Simmons is an established firm at a growth inflection point, and we're building toward the clients who need us most.

Position summary

Ayoroa Simmons is seeking a Senior BIM/VDC Project Manager to lead model-based coordination and digital delivery across complex AEC projects, while supporting client relationships, strategic pursuits, and firm growth. The ideal candidate brings technical credibility and client-facing leadership, managing BIM/VDC execution, advising project teams, and representing the firm in pursuits.

This is a fully remote role with some travel expected.

Key responsibilities

BIM/VDC project leadership

  • Align BIM/VDC scope, schedule, budget, and staffing with overall project goals.
  • Lead BIM/VDC execution from pursuit and preconstruction through construction and closeout, including BIM Execution Plans, model coordination strategies, and deliverable schedules.
  • Serve as primary BIM/VDC point of contact for owners, design teams, contractors, trade partners, and internal staff.
  • Establish QA/QC protocols for models, documentation, and coordination milestones; identify risks early and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Support and guide Project Leads in running multidisciplinary coordination meetings, clash detection workflows, constructability reviews, and issue resolution, staying actively engaged while empowering Project Leads to own day-to-day meeting leadership.

Client relationships & pursuits

  • Build and maintain relationships with clients, contractors, design partners, and industry stakeholders; identify opportunities for new work, expanded services, and follow-on assignments.
  • Support go/no-go decisions, capture planning, proposal development, and win strategy for BIM/VDC-related opportunities.
  • Participate in client meetings, shortlist presentations, and pursuit strategy sessions; contribute technical content and value propositions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor, translating client goals into BIM/VDC scopes, work plans, and deliverables.
  • Manage assigned consultants and trade partners, including coordination of their scope, project invoicing, and billing.
  • Represent Ayoroa Simmons at industry events and conferences; partner with principals and marketing to align VDC capabilities with firm growth.

Technology, standards & process improvement

  • Develop and maintain BIM/VDC standards, templates, workflows, and best practices across projects and offices.
  • Evaluate and select BIM/VDC software, including Autodesk, Bluebeam, and comparable platforms, to advance leading industry workflows and production.
  • Drive innovation in Revit and coordination workflows, extending the firm's established leadership in scanning and reality capture; implement automation, dashboards, and emerging technologies (4D scheduling, digital twins, reality capture, prefabrication).
  • Train and mentor project teams on coordination processes, tools, and digital delivery expectations.

Team leadership & mentorship

  • Supervise, mentor, and develop BIM/VDC coordinators, specialists, and modelers.
  • Provide technical guidance to project managers, discipline leads, and field teams.
  • Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment; promote knowledge sharing across projects and markets.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field; equivalent experience welcomed.
  • 8+ years in BIM, VDC, construction technology, or digital project delivery, including 3+ years leading BIM/VDC on complex AEC projects.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting client relationships, pursuits, proposals, or presentations.
  • Advanced proficiency with Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Forma, and similar platforms.
  • Experience developing BIM Execution Plans, clash detection workflows, and model standards.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills; ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, commercial, higher education, infrastructure, or mission-critical sectors.
  • Established client or industry network in the Eastern U.S. AEC market.
  • Experience with 4D/5D integration, digital twins, laser scanning, reality capture, or prefabrication workflows.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, automation, scripting, or model-based analytics.
  • Experience with project scheduling (Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project).
  • Professional certifications: CM-BIM, PMP, DBIA, LEED AP, or Autodesk certification.

Key competencies

BIM/VDC technical leadership · Client relationship management · Project delivery accountability · Constructability judgment · Pursuit & proposal support · Team mentorship · Process improvement · Data-driven decision-making

Success measures

  • On-time delivery of BIM/VDC scope, milestones, and model standards.
  • Reduction in coordination issues, RFIs, rework, and field conflicts.
  • Client satisfaction, repeat work, and new opportunities identified or supported.
  • Proposal shortlist and win contributions; revenue or backlog influenced.
  • Adoption of improved VDC workflows and development of BIM/VDC team members.

Compensation & benefits

  • Base salary: $125,000–$160,000, based on experience and qualifications
  • Performance-based bonus tied to business development outcomes
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match
  • 3 weeks PTO (120 hours), pro-rated in year one; paid holidays
  • Fully remote with minimal travel
  • Professional development, certification support, and conference participation
  • Mentorship, leadership development, and clear career advancement pathways

Equal Employment Opportunity

Ayoroa Simmons is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, with fair treatment regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, or pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, or genetic information.

Title VI Compliance

Ayoroa Simmons ensures nondiscrimination in all programs and activities in accordance with Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. For assistance or accommodations for individuals with disabilities or limited English proficiency, please contact our Title VI Coordinator, Kim Short, at (866) 726-2246.

Salary: $125,000–$160,000
