jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Hummingbird is a remote-first, fully distributed team united by the shared mission of helping fight financial crime.
jobs.description:
Hummingbird is a remote-first, fully distributed team united by the shared mission of helping fight financial crime. Since our launch in 2017, we’ve helped major financial institutions and tech-savvy trailblazers alike (e.g. Stripe, Affirm, Evolve Bank etc.) orchestrate their compliance programs through our thoughtfully designed, intuitive SaaS product. We believe finding and stopping financial crime is a problem rooted in code, language and design, so we built the product that the heroes doing this work deserve.

We are customer-obsessed, and we love building and shipping great products. We set a high bar, challenge our assumptions, seek diverse opinions, and support each other to do our best work.

We do our best to write inclusive, descriptive and accurate job descriptions, but we’re not always perfect. If you’re interested in the role, we’d love to hear from you even if you don’t feel like you meet everything we’re looking for. We’re always iterating and improving, and it’s possible that your experience is even more impactful than we could have imagined.

About the role

At Hummingbird, we want to build better software to fight financial crime. Our engineering team is responsible for making that a reality. They dive deep into the problems that make financial crime fighting so difficult and design flexible, scalable solutions that empower our customers to catch the bad guys. Our product sits at the intersection of financial technology, data science, security, policy, law enforcement, and design. As employees at a small startup, software engineers at Hummingbird have the opportunity to wear many hats and learn and grow across a multitude of dimensions.

The Trust team owns the platform that everything else runs on. As a Senior Security Engineer on Trust, you'll be the person driving security across Hummingbird's infrastructure -- protecting a data set that includes some of the most sensitive finaical information imaginable, growing fast. The threat landscape is evolving quickly, especially AI: we're navigating security risks introduced by AI built into our product, the need to govern how our team uses AI tools internally, and increasingly sophisticated AI-powered external attacks. You'll have real ownership of this work, from hands on engineering to shaping our security posture for years to come.

What you'll do:

  • Drives security engineering across Hummingbird's infrastructure. You'll help lead our security posture: managing vulnerability and dependency tooling, designing and enforcing controls, and ensuring our AWS environment — managed via Terraform — is hardened and audit-ready for the tier 1 financial institutions we serve.
  • Work with a small, passionate, and experienced team: We're a small team of mostly senior engineers and we love to do great work together. We're fully remote, but we make a strong effort to prioritize, design, and code collaboratively.
  • Grapple with the challenges of working in a high security, high stakes environment: We work with some of the most sensitive data you can imagine and provide a critical service to our customers. You'll help develop a threat intelligence program that monitors the external landscape and connects it to our internal risks, including incident response and disaster recovery.
  • Influence the overall architecture and hosting strategy: Great ideas come from everywhere. Everyone on the team has a voice in technical discussions, and is trusted to make significant decisions.
  • Have the opportunity to grow into leadership: Hummingbird is growing rapidly. As we do, there will be opportunities for engineers to take on new roles in product, technology, or people leadership positions.

About you:

  • 7+ years of experience, including 3–5 years in a dedicated security engineering role (Security Engineer, AppSec Engineer, or equivalent), preferably with some startup experience.
  • You love digging into complex problems and determining both the root cause and the best solution to fix.
  • You're happy spelunking logs and running diagnostic tools to make sure you understand the problem.
  • You sail through ambiguity and are comfortable across the infrastructure layer — Terraform and AWS are your tools, not mysteries. You can move between network security and encryption, access controls and permissions, and high-level architecture without losing the thread.
  • Iteration is part of the fun. You’re not married to specific ideas or solutions.
  • You want your impact to go beyond the lines of code you write.

About Babyscripts

Babyscripts is a leading innovator in digital maternal health, transforming pregnancy and postpartum care through remote patient monitoring (RPM) and digital engagement. Our solutions enable OB providers and health systems to monitor patients in real time, improving access, early intervention, and overall outcomes in maternal-fetal health.

About the Role

We are seeking a Qualified Healthcare Provider (QHCP) — Nurse Practitioner, Physician Assistant, or Certified Nurse Midwife — to join our remote clinical operations team on a fractional or part-time basis.

This role requires active licensure in the state of Texas, as the provider will support patients and clinical partners located in Texas.

In this role, you will leverage your clinical expertise to review vitals data, assess patient communications, and document clinical summaries that support key customer and quality requirements. The QHCP will also participate in targeted patient outreach for elevated readings, symptoms, or follow-up coordination as part of our virtual maternal health model.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced clinician seeking flexible, remote work while contributing meaningfully to a growing digital health company advancing maternal outcomes nationwide.

Time Commitment: Approximately 10–20 hours per week, with flexibility based on business needs and case volume.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor patient data trends (e.g., blood pressure, weight, symptoms) and identify high-risk cases requiring intervention.
  • Perform clinical assessments via phone, telehealth, or messaging to provide education, intervention, and care plan adjustments.
  • Provide direct patient education on managing hypertension, gestational diabetes, preeclampsia risks, postpartum recovery, and other maternal health concerns.
  • Escalate high-risk cases to the appropriate provider per established protocols.
  • Support care coordination by assisting patients with referrals, scheduling follow-ups, and connecting them to additional resources.
  • Ensure compliance with RPM protocols by coaching patients on adherence and addressing barriers to engagement.
  • Document all clinical interactions in Babyscripts' care management platform, ensuring accuracy and compliance with healthcare regulations.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Clinical Data Review: Analyze patient vitals data (e.g., blood pressure, glucose, weight, symptoms) and message histories to identify trends, risk factors, and potential clinical concerns.
  • Clinical Documentation: Create and validate summary notes or Evidence of Care (EoC) reports supporting provider review and quality reporting requirements.
  • Patient Outreach: Conduct focused patient outreach via phone or secure messaging to verify readings, reinforce care plans, or assess for warning signs when needed.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure data completeness, appropriate clinical coding alignment, and compliance with Babyscripts protocols and payer requirements.
  • Provider Coordination: Escalate abnormal findings or nonresponsive patients per established triage and escalation pathways.
  • Continuous Improvement: Provide clinical feedback to support optimization of Babyscripts’ workflows, triggers, and RPM care logic.

Qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted NP, PA, or CNM license in the state of Texas (required).
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of clinical experience in OB/GYN, women’s health, maternal-fetal medicine, or related fields.
  • Prior experience with remote patient monitoring, telehealth, or population health preferred.
  • Strong ability to synthesize data and communicate concise clinical insights.
  • Comfort navigating EHRs, care management platforms, and digital tools.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Bilingual (Spanish) strongly preferred.

Compensation & Structure

  • Type: Fractional / 1099 or W2 part-time (based on preference and local regulations).
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly or per-review rate, commensurate with experience and licensure.
  • Incentives: Eligible for quality- and performance-based bonuses (documentation accuracy, turnaround time, engagement metrics).
  • Flexibility: Fully remote; scheduling coordinated with the clinical operations lead based on coverage needs.

Note: Part-time employees are not eligible for full-time medical, dental, vision, or 401(k) benefits, but may be eligible for select company perks depending on hours worked and tenure.

Staffing & Coverage Expectations

  • Maintain consistent availability during agreed-upon hours (e.g., 10–20 hrs/week).
  • Communicate any planned time off or coverage changes in advance to maintain patient continuity.
  • Participate in clinical huddles or team updates as scheduled (typically brief and virtual).

Please Note: Applicants must hold an active NP, PA, or CNM license in the state of Texas to be considered for this role. Licensure in additional states is welcome but not required.

Houd je van 'mensenwerk'? Van een afwisselende, boeiende baan waarin iedere dag anders is? Van een functie waarin je vanuit huis werkt, jouw eigen tijd in kunt delen en er alle ruimte is voor eigen inbreng? Bouw je eigen klantenkring op in de regio waar jij werkt. Leer nieuwe singels kennen in jouw regio en vind matches.

Taken

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het inschrijven en begeleiden van singles die serieus een nieuwe relatie zoeken. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega-matchmakers in de nabijgelegen regio's. Als matchmaker van Mens & Relatie werk je bij het grootste bureau in persoonlijke relatiebemiddeling in Nederland.

Vereisten

  • Je kunt goed omgaan met mensen en heeft veel mensenkennis.
  • Je hebt minimaal een HBO werk-/denkniveau
  • Je heeft de beschikking over een auto
  • Je hebt een uitstekende telefonische bereikbaarheid
  • Je hebt geen bezwaar tegen flexibele werktijden
  • Je bent woonachtig in Doetinchem of omgeving (max. 20 km)

De relatieconsulent die wij zoeken is uitstekend in staat om zijn/haar eigen werk in te delen. Hij/zij is zelfstandig, gemotiveerd en beschikt over een groot inlevingsvermogen, heeft een open- en communicatief karakter en beschikt over een meer dan gemiddelde interesse in mensen en in wat hen bezighoudt.

Benefits

  • Een baan waarin je mensen bij elkaar mag brengen!
  • Een baan waarin alle ruimte is voor eigen inbreng
  • Een parttime baan waarin je jouw eigen tijd in kunt delen
  • Een freelance baan waarin de hoogte van jouw inkomen afhankelijk van jouw inzet en motivatie.

Als relatieconsulent werk je op de manier zoals het jou uitkomt. Aan deze flexibiliteit zit wellicht één nadeel. Mens & Relatie biedt geen vast dienstverband met dito inkomen. Hoewel een consulente bij Mens & Relatie doorgaans meer verdient dan iemand met een vergelijkbare functie in het bedrijfsleven, ben je in principe zelf verantwoordelijk voor de hoogte van jouw inkomen.

Wij verzorgen jouw opleiding tot professionele matchmaker. Daarnaast verzorgen wij de marketing en ondersteunen wij jou administratief.

Verder krijg je de beschikking over de nieuwste software om jou behulpzaam te zijn bij het maken van de juiste match. Kortom, wij helpen je om, succesvol, jouw eigen praktijk op te bouwen.

RN Care Manager PART TIME – BabyscriptsAbout Babyscripts

Babyscripts is a leading innovator in digital health, dedicated to transforming maternal care through remote patient monitoring (RPM) and patient engagement. Our digital tools help healthcare providers monitor, educate, and support their patients in real-time, enhancing overall care coordination and improving maternal and fetal health outcomes.

About the Role

We are seeking a part-time RN Care Manager to support maternal health patients through care coordination, remote patient monitoring, and clinical assessment. This role is ideal for licensed Registered Nurses (RNs) with experience in case management, maternal health, or telehealth who are looking for a flexible position in a digital care environment.

As a part-time team member, you will monitor patient data, conduct clinical assessments, educate patients, and escalate high-risk cases to providers using established protocols. You’ll play an important role in improving maternal health outcomes—while working remotely with a flexible schedule aligned to business needs.

This is a remote, part-time (approximately 24 hours/week) position, with some flexibility around days and hours.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor patient data trends (e.g., blood pressure, weight, symptoms) and identify high-risk cases requiring intervention.
  • Perform clinical assessments via phone, telehealth, or messaging to provide education, intervention, and care plan adjustments.
  • Provide direct patient education on managing hypertension, gestational diabetes, preeclampsia risks, postpartum recovery, and other maternal health concerns.
  • Escalate high-risk cases to the appropriate provider per established protocols.
  • Support care coordination by assisting patients with referrals, scheduling follow-ups, and connecting them to additional resources.
  • Ensure compliance with RPM protocols by coaching patients on adherence and addressing barriers to engagement.
  • Document all clinical interactions in Babyscripts' care management platform, ensuring accuracy and compliance with healthcare regulations.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Active, unrestricted RN license in the U.S. (multi-state compact license preferred).
  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience in maternal health, OB/GYN, case management, remote patient monitoring, or other relevant fields.
  • Experience in telehealth, digital health, or RPM platforms is highly preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills to manage maternal health risks effectively.
  • Excellent patient communication skills with the ability to educate, engage, and empower patients in their care.
  • Proficiency with EHRs, care management platforms, and digital health tools.
  • Bilingual (Spanish preferred).

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: Based on experience and licensure; part-time compensation is pro-rated based on a 24-hour workweek.
  • Quarterly Bonuses: Eligible based on patient engagement, quality benchmarks, and documentation accuracy (pro-rated based on hours worked).
  • Flexible Scheduling: Self-managed hours in coordination with team needs and coverage goals.
  • Remote Work:
    • Work-from-home stipend available.

Note: Part-time employees are not eligible for full-time medical, dental, vision, or 401(k) benefits, but may be eligible for select company perks depending on hours worked and tenure.

Staffing & Coverage Expectations

  • Maintain a consistent 24-hour/week schedule, with flexibility around days and hours based on team coverage needs.
  • Coordinate any changes in availability or time off in advance to ensure patient continuity.
  • In the case of urgent PTO, coordinate handoffs with the team to ensure no disruption in patient care.

jobs.excerpt: Senior C++ Software EngineerRemote (UK-based) | Full-TimeAbout UsReactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year ().
jobs.description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.
